assessments.reasoning: The Operation entry paragraph on printed page 17 identifies the operation entry as mandatory and places it on the line carrying any name entry. The preceding coding section places both entries on the first line when a name is present.

challenge.method: Checked the optional-name description, contrasting comment format on printed page 16, first-line rule, and dependent operand/remarks handling on printed pages 17 and 18.
challenge.results: A name entry is generally optional but the operation entry is still required for an instruction statement. Comments follow their separate syntax. The operand and remarks rules do not alter operation placement.

limitations: This is an instruction statement rule in SC26-4940-07. It does not establish validity of individual operation codes.
